editingNote: Editing an existing record. Every field is loaded from what was saved.

description.tp: Institutions and organisations contributing to the delivery of the training programme.
description.pp: Partners supporting local producers with advisory services, processing, finance and market access.
description.tc: One record per participant per training, carrying the completion decision that counts towards A1.3.
description.ln: Each profile joins one farmer from the completion records to one production-support partner.
description.ex: Municipal markets and exhibitions organised under the Action Plan. Only events already held count towards E0.1.
description.rg: Producer registrations per event. Registrations from the producer portal wait for municipality approval.
description.fu: Follow-up interviews at six and twelve months. Forty-three questions across six sections.

registration.newHelp: New producer. This national ID is not yet in the system.
registration.lookupHelp: Typing a known national ID fills the name and phone automatically.
registration.producerType: What type of producer are you?
registration.firstTime: Is this your first municipal market or exhibition?

deleteNote.tp: A1.2 and G0.4 drop by one immediately. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.pp: C1.1 and G0.4 drop by one immediately. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.ln: C1.2 drops by one immediately. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.ex: E0.1 drops by one if the event had already been held. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.tc: A1.3 and D0.1 are recalculated in the next quarterly return. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.rg: E0.2 is recalculated in the next quarterly return. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.fu: A1, B1, C1 and IMP-0 are recalculated in the next quarterly return. This cannot be undone.
